description: The file defines a PHP class DateTimeHelperService within the OrangeHRM project, providing various date and time utility functions such as formatting dates, comparing dates, converting seconds to time strings, calculating date differences, generating date ranges, and retrieving week boundaries. It includes constants for specific weekdays and last week mappings, and utilizes traits and external classes for configuration and localization support.

classes.name: DateTimeHelperService
classes.description: Provides utility functions for date and time operations, including formatting, comparison, range generation, and week boundary calculations.

methods.name: getDateFormatter
methods.description: Returns an instance of LocalizedDateFormatter, creating one if not already instantiated.

methods.name: formatDateTimeToYmd
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object to a 'Y-m-d' string; returns null if input is null.

methods.name: formatDateTimeToTimeString
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object to 'H:i' or 'H:i:s' string based on withSeconds parameter.

methods.name: convertSecondsToTimeString
methods.description: Converts seconds into a formatted time string ('H:i' or 'H:i:s').

methods.name: isDatesEqual
methods.description: Checks if two DateTime objects have the same date (ignoring time), with an option to accept null values.

methods.name: dateDiffInHours
methods.description: Calculates the difference in hours between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: dateRange
methods.description: Generates an array of DateTime objects between two dates, with a specified interval.

methods.name: getNow
methods.description: Returns the current DateTime, possibly with a specified timezone.

methods.name: getNowInUTC
methods.description: Returns the current DateTime in UTC timezone.

methods.name: getTimezoneByTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns a DateTimeZone object for a given float offset, e.g., +5.30.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object based on configuration settings or defaults to Y-m-d.

methods.name: getWeekBoundaryForGivenDate
methods.description: Calculates the start and end dates of the week for a given date, based on specified week start day index.
